newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALIAN PLAYER ARRESTED IN DRUGS CASE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALIAN PLAYER ARRESTED IN DRUGS CASE.

text.p: A player with Italian second division soccer club Castel di Sangro was arrested on Friday on suspicion of involvement in international drugs trafficking.
Police said defender Pierluigi Prete, 30, was arrested at his home in Castel di Sangro, a small town in central Italy.
Police sources said the player's wife, Chilean citizen Lorena Carillo Diaz, was arrested in Rome last December after arriving from Belgium with one kilo (2.2 pounds) of pure cocaine.
A spokeswoman for the struggling soccer club, which was promoted from serie C at the end of last season, said the arrest had nothing to do with Castel di Sangro.
"We stress that the episode is completely alien to the affairs of this club," she said.
The arrest was the second time the club, from a town nestling in the central Abruzzi mountains with a population of around 5,600 people, has hit the news headlines.
Last December, two of its players were killed in a motorway car crash while returning from an away match.
